text:
Priya: Found GCS object in partner-artifacts (gs://partner-artifacts/ci/workspace_blob.enc) that starts with 'vault:v2:9f8a...' Looks like Vault transit-wrapped blob, partner-ci-sa had read perms.
sec-bot: Alert: external-gcs-read detected (rule:gcs-external-access). Incident 1769129999 opened.
Alex: paste gs path + first ~60 chars of blob (no secret material).
Priya: gs://partner-artifacts/ci/workspace_blob.enc
Priya: header (sanitized): `vault:v2:9f8a2b...c7d` — transit-style wrapper, not raw Cloud KMS envelope.
Tom: transit ciphertext implies anyone with transit/unwrap on our Vault could decrypt if they could call the API. Check cross-project workload identity and SA bindings.
Lina: maps to onboarding role partner-ci-sa@partner-prod — binding in infra-onboard project (expires 2026-11). It had roles/storage.objectViewer and a custom role vault-proxy-invoke.
Alex: immediate containment — remove binding + disable SA keys.
Alex: gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding infra-onboard --member="serviceAccount:partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/storage.objectViewer"
Alex: gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Alex: gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Tom: Enable Vault audit for transit and forward logs to central:
  vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_transit.log
(then ship to splunk/central-logging, retain 90d).
Alex: rotate transit key + rewrap affected blobs (canary then prod):
  vault write -f transit/keys/ci-transit-key/rotate
  vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=\"<old>\" key=\"ci-transit-key\"
Priya: scanning partner-artifacts for vault:v2: blobs now.
Priya: found 4 blobs under ci/, 1 with vault:v2: prefix. Uploaded scrubbed keys list to /sec/artifacts/1769129999.txt and notified partner SOC (no plaintext).
LegalBot: Legal & partner notification started. Partner requested timeline and scrubbed artifact list.
Oncall: containment executed — binding removed, SA keys disabled. Handoff to EngSec for rotation + audit review.
Tom: audit check: two failed transit/unwrap attempts (403) in last 30d, no successful unwraps. Proceed with rotation and RBAC tightening: make decrypt explicit to internal identities only.
Alex: example Vault policy HCL to tighten:
path \"transit/encrypt/*\" { capabilities = [\"update\"] }
path \"transit/decrypt/*\" { capabilities = [\"update\"] # restrict to internal-service entity }
Priya: will run wider scan across partner projects overnight and post results to the incident.
Tom: rewrap completed for the single affected blob; rotation propagated. Audits show no successful unwraps. Marking incident as mitigated and scheduling 1h postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
Priya: attaching artifact list and command logs to the ticket. Thanks team.
